'''Ezam Nhor''' was a young [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as his people's liaison to the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="JK" /> Nhor was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="JK" />

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref>, he joined [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in their scouting mission to the planet [[Borao]], which later became the new Ithorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="JK" />
